title: OFC Financial Categories Catalog
description: Controlled vocabulary for classifying financial items extracted from football match financial reports.

currency_convention.sign_convention: Amounts are stored as non-negative absolute values. Their financial meaning is determined by financial_class and accounting_role.

financial_classes.description: Amounts generated by the match and recorded as revenue.
Costs associated with organizing and operating the match.
Fees, administrative charges and institutional charges.
Amounts deducted from gross revenue that are not classified as operating expenses, taxes or fees.
Corrections, transfers or accounting adjustments affecting the reported result.
Financial items whose nature is known but does not fit another class.
Items whose financial nature could not be reliably identified.

accounting_roles.description: Preserved for analysis but excluded from financial totals.
Not included in calculated financial totals until classified.

categories.name: Ticket Sales
categories.description: Revenue from paid match tickets.

categories.name: Membership Ticket Revenue
categories.description: Revenue from tickets or admission allocated to club members, when separately reported.

categories.name: Other Match Revenue
categories.description: Other revenue directly attributable to the match.

categories.name: Match Sponsorship Revenue
categories.description: Sponsorship revenue specifically attributed to the match.

categories.name: Security
categories.description: Security personnel and services associated with the match.

categories.name: Cleaning
categories.description: Cleaning services and related match operations.

categories.name: Medical Services
categories.description: Medical personnel and healthcare services.

categories.name: Ambulance
categories.description: Ambulance availability and emergency transport services.

categories.name: Video Assistant Referee
categories.description: VAR services and associated match costs.

categories.name: Refereeing
categories.description: Refereeing fees and match officials' operational costs, when classified as match expenses.

categories.name: Stadium Operations
categories.description: Costs related to stadium operation and match-day infrastructure.

categories.name: Match Personnel
categories.description: Operational personnel other than categories separately identified.

categories.name: Match Logistics
categories.description: Logistics and operational support directly associated with the match.

categories.name: Other Operating Expenses
categories.description: Identified match operating expenses without a more specific category.

categories.name: ISS
categories.description: Municipal service tax.

categories.name: Other Taxes
categories.description: Other identified taxes and statutory fiscal charges.

categories.name: Federation Fees
categories.description: Fees charged by the competition organizer or football federation.

categories.name: Administrative Fees
categories.description: Administrative fees related to match organization.

categories.name: Other Fees
categories.description: Other identified fees not covered by a more specific category.

categories.name: Ticketing and Payment Deductions
categories.description: Deductions related to ticketing, payment processing or ticket distribution.

categories.name: Other Deductions
categories.description: Other deductions from match revenue whose nature is identified.

categories.name: Transfers and Allocations
categories.description: Transfers or allocations affecting the match financial result.

categories.name: Financial Corrections
categories.description: Corrections or adjustments to reported financial values.

categories.name: Informational Item
categories.description: An item preserved for context but not included in financial totals.

categories.name: Unclassified Financial Item
categories.description: An item whose nature cannot yet be reliably classified.
